description:
First real-frame ticket. Replace `capture::sim::SimCapture` with a real PipeWire ScreenCast capture backend that satisfies the minimum subset of N-003 needed for an end-to-end recording on a single Linux compositor. The simulator stays available behind `--simulate`; the real path is the default.

Scope (binding):
- Add the `capture::pipewire` module backed by the `pipewire-rs` crate (pin a version; document choice in helper crate README per N-003 §19).
- Implement the portal call order from N-003 §16: `CreateSession` → `SelectSources(types=MONITOR, cursor_mode=Embedded, persist_mode=Transient)` → `Start` → `OpenPipeWireRemote` → `pw_stream_connect`. Only `monitor` mode in this ticket — `window` and `region` are deferred to a follow-up sub-ticket if needed for T-021.
- Implement the `CaptureSource` trait surface from N-003 §4: `caps()`, `current_format()`, `frames()`, `pause()`, `resume()`, `stop()`. Implementation behind `Arc<dyn CaptureSource + Send + Sync>`.
- Format negotiation per N-003 §8: advertise `NV12` first, accept what the compositor returns. Reject anything other than `NV12`/`P010`/`XR24`/`AR24` with `format-renegotiation-failed`. Only `NV12` actually flows in this ticket — other formats reach the encoder layer in T-017.
- Buffer mode negotiation per N-003 §7: prefer DMA-BUF with modifier list from `gbm`; fall back to SHM if compositor rejects. Linear DMA-BUF is acceptable. If neither works → `capture.sessionLost { reason: "no-acceptable-buffer-type" }`.
- Emit the events per N-007 §6 / N-003 §2: `capture.sessionReady` once and only once when `pw_stream` state reaches `Streaming`; `capture.formatChanged` on `OnParamChanged` mid-stream; `capture.streamPaused`/`streamResumed` on compositor pause/resume; `capture.sessionLost` per N-003 §12 reason codes; `capture.diagnostics` at 1 Hz per N-003 §14 schema.
- Restore-token persistence per N-003 §5: write `$XDG_STATE_HOME/cove-screen-recorder/portal-restore.json`; read on next `requestSession` and pass to portal. Reject path traversal in the file (sanity check).
- Cursor mode: only `embedded` in this ticket (the default per N-003 §10). `hidden`/`metadata` modes deferred.
- Frame channel: `FrameHandle` per N-003 §4. Buffers carry DRM fds + plane metadata for DMA-BUF, or `Shm { ptr, len, stride }` for SHM. `ReleaseToken` returns buffers to PipeWire's pool. The frame channel terminates at a downstream consumer that, in this ticket, is a counting sink (no encoder yet — that's T-017).
- Hook into the dispatcher: `capture.requestSession` / `capture.startStream` / `capture.stopSession` / `capture.pauseStream` / `capture.resumeStream` use the real backend when `--simulate` is OFF.
- Diagnostics: every dropped frame is counted and reported in `capture.diagnostics.buffers.dropped_since_last`. A dropped frame is a buffer the PipeWire callback could not enqueue into the frame channel within one frame interval.
- Environment probe: extend `coveApi.env.probe()` (via main → helper `engine.env.probe` or equivalent — choose one and document) to report `pipewire.coreVersion`, `xdg-desktop-portal.version`, GPU vendor per N-007 §20.

Out of scope (binding):
- No `window` mode, no `region` mode (Issue #1 absorption). Deferred — either folded into this ticket as a sub-step on completion of monitor mode OR opened as a follow-up sub-ticket T-016a (implementer's call; default = follow-up).
- No `hidden` or `metadata` cursor modes.
- No encoder integration. Frames terminate at a counting sink.
- No segment buffer.
- No HDR / 10-bit pipeline (P010 negotiation is allowed but consumer fallback is undefined).
- No Wayland-without-portal path. No X11.
- No Windows WGC.
- No tests against the matrix machines (M2/M3/M4) — that's T-010c. This ticket targets M1 alone.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Helper boots in NON-simulate mode on M1 (Arch / KDE Plasma 6 / Wayland / NVIDIA RTX 40-class).
2. A JSON-RPC client driving `requestSession({mode:"monitor"})` → `startStream` causes the KDE portal picker to appear; selecting a monitor causes `capture.sessionReady` to fire within 1.5 s of user confirmation, with a CaptureFormat carrying real dimensions.
3. `capture.diagnostics` fires at ~1 Hz with `total_produced` increasing at the source's actual rate (e.g. ~60/sec at 60 Hz).
4. Idle source (no damage) for 10 s produces fewer than 60 frames/sec in `total_produced` — no synthetic frames generated (N-003 §9.2).
5. `capture.stopSession` cleanly tears down `pw_stream` and the portal session. No leaked PipeWire connections (`pw-cli list-objects` after 5 s shows no helper-owned streams).
6. User cancelling the portal picker produces `capture.sessionLost { reason: "portal-denied" }`.
7. xdg-desktop-portal absent (test by stopping it before launch) produces `capture.sessionLost { reason: "portal-unavailable" }`.
8. Restore token round-trip works: relaunching the helper with a stored token suppresses the picker.
9. `--simulate` flag from T-015 still works unchanged.

Verification commands:
- `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine`
- `cargo test -p cove-replay-engine` (any unit tests; full integration is manual on M1)
- Manual on M1: launch helper, drive the round-trip from the dev preload smoke harness (T-014) or `socat`, verify portal picker and diagnostics counters.
- `pgrep -a cove-replay-engine` after stopSession + 5 s — must show no children.
- `git status --short`

Codex review expectations:
- Confirm portal call order matches N-003 §16 exactly.
- Confirm `capture.sessionReady` fires only after `pw_stream` state reaches `Streaming` (N-003 §5 / §16 step 7) — not on `Connected`, not on a timer.
- Confirm DMA-BUF is attempted before SHM (N-003 §7).
- Confirm no synthetic frames are produced when the source is idle (N-003 §9.2). This is the load-bearing v1.1.0 regression-killer.
- Confirm Issue #3 absorption: capture continues with the Electron preview window minimised — must hold even though renderer wiring isn't fully migrated in this ticket. A targeted test using the dev preload harness suffices.
- Confirm restore-token JSON is sanitised (path traversal rejected).
- Confirm `capture.diagnostics` schema matches N-003 §14.
- Flag any panic path or `unwrap()` that survives review.

Failure handling:
- If `pipewire-rs` has a known soundness or version-pinning issue, document it in the helper README and proceed with the chosen workaround. Do not silently switch to raw FFI without documenting.
- If two attempts to bring up a working PipeWire stream on M1 fail, stop and hand the ticket back per WORKFLOW.md "Failed fix reset" — do not keep adding speculative workarounds.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
title: Implement PipeWire capture MVP (monitor mode, NV12, sessionReady)
